description: PAID, offer offer_chain_verify_v1 (0.25 USD per verification, up to 10,000 records). Send a hash-chained list (log, ledger, receipts). Each record's hash must equal the hash of its own content and its prev must equal the previous record's hash. Returns valid true/false, the first break, every break with its reason and expected hash, the input's sha256 and a receipt signed into AETHER's hash chain. Your records are checked in memory and not stored; only the verdict and a digest are recorded. credit_token comes from aether_redeem after paying, or directly from the x402 door https://angelscohq.com/aether/x402/<offer_id>. It is tied to one offer.

credit_token.description: Token for offer_chain_verify_v1. credit_token comes from aether_redeem after paying, or directly from the x402 door https://angelscohq.com/aether/x402/<offer_id>. It is tied to one offer.

genesis_prev.description: Optional expected prev value of the first record.

hash_field.description: Field holding the record's own hash (default 'hash').

records.description: Array of record objects in chain order (oldest first).

scheme.description: How each hash was computed: concat = sha256(prev+data), concat_pipe = sha256(prev+'|'+data), json_canonical = sha256 of sorted-key compact JSON of {data, prev}. Non-string data is serialised as sorted-key compact JSON. Default concat.

name: aether_verify_chain
title: Hash-chain integrity verification (paid)
